question: A 31-year-old man presents for his annual physical exam. The physician fails to palpate a ductus deferens on the left side. An ultrasound confirms absence of the left ductus deferens and further reveals absence of the left epididymis, seminal vesicle, and kidney. Spermogram and reproductive hormones panel are within normal limits. Left-sided agenesis of an embryonic anlage is suspected. Which two structures are connected by this anlage during embryogenesis?
analysis: During embryogenesis, the mesonephros and cloaca are connected by an anlage. The absence of left-sided structures in the patient suggests agenesis of the embryonic anlage that would have given rise to these structures.
